drugs.name: maropitant (injectable)
notes: 1 mg/kg SC or IV once daily (SID)
Same table also lists 1 mg/kg PO q24h
SC may be painful (guideline adverse-effect note)
Hospital stock: Prevomax / Cerenia injectable 10 mg/mL
drugs.source: 2026 iCatCare consensus guidelines on CKD in cats (Taylor et al. JFMS 2026) Table 4 — maropitant 1 mg/kg SC, IV or PO q24h. DOI 10.1177/1098612X261466553

drugs.name: maropitant (tablets / PO)
notes: 1 mg/kg PO q24h (SID) for nausea/vomiting — iCatCare Table 4
OFF-LABEL vs Cerenia tablets (dog-only oral licence); injectable is labelled for cats
Using 16/24 mg dog tablets in cats is extra-label — score carefully; small cats may need compounding
Guideline cites Quimby oral CKD trial (~4 mg/cat/day, median ~1.1 mg/kg)
drugs.source: 2026 iCatCare consensus guidelines on CKD in cats (Taylor et al. JFMS 2026) Table 4 — maropitant 1 mg/kg SC, IV or PO q24h. DOI 10.1177/1098612X261466553
